deviation: The draft extends the breach notification deadline from 48 hours to 5 days, which is worse than both the standard and the 72-hour fallback. A slower notice leaves Arcadia less time to contain the breach, meet its own regulatory notification deadlines (e.g. 72 hours under GDPR) and protect affected individuals.
suggested_text: The Supplier shall notify the Customer of any personal data breach within 48 hours of becoming aware.
